pr.title: Teach agents to use directed BRC messages for coordination (#1718)
pr.description:
Resolves #1718. The `egg-orch message send` CLI already supports directed peer-to-peer
coordination (exists at `sandbox/egg_lib/orch_cli.py:978`, registered at line 1777), but
agents don't know when to use it — the BRC preamble only covers consensus primitives.
This PR adds prompt-level guidance for producers and reviewers, fixes the CLI --type help
text to mention HANDOFF, and documents the pattern with a worked example.

Note to reviewers: proposal #1 of the issue ("Add egg-orch message send") was already
implemented before this PR; this PR addresses only the remaining prompt + docs gap.
Related to #1717 (persistence) but independent — real-time coordination value is captured
without persistence.

- Manual: run `egg-orch message send --help` and confirm `HANDOFF` appears in the --type

- Manual: read `docs/guides/concurrent-execution.md` and confirm the new "Directed
  Coordination" subsection renders cleanly with the worked example.
